items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: 1925, Andrew Blakeney recorded with the Sonny Clay's Plantation Orchestra in Los Angeles

ctx.x: MS. REDD: 1925, Andrew Blakeney recorded with the Sonny Clay's Plantation Orchestra in Los Angeles, on Vocalian Label, 1000. This was a 78 disc. The personnel included Ernest Coycault, first trumpet; W.B. Woodman, trombone; Leonard Davidson, clarinet; and James Carson, clarinet and tenor sax; Louis Dodd, alto sax, banjo, guitar; Willie McDaniel, drums.
Mr. Blakeney states that he did not recall the presence of a Mr. Fitzgerald on this particular date. The sounds recorded were "Plantation Blues" and "Chicago Breakdown."
